questions.question: When there's unresolved tension between you and someone else:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Address it now. You'd rather have the conversation than carry it.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Wait for the right moment. You're usually the one who resolves it.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Go quiet. Most things aren't worth the energy.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Feel everything first. Say something when you're sure what it is.

answers.label: A
answers.text: Busy. Noise. Energy around you that you can plug into.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Alone. Minimal. No one interrupting your thinking.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Quiet and organized. You know where everything is.

answers.label: D
answers.text: High stakes. Something that demands everything you've got.

answers.label: A
answers.text: Stillness that isn't empty — when the quiet finally means something.

answers.label: B
answers.text: The moment right after you've held on through something hard.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Clarity. When you know what matters and nothing else is making noise.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Momentum. When things are moving and you're part of it.

questions.question: After something hard, you come back by:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Returning to your routines. Structure is how you restore.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Getting back into motion. Inaction makes it worse.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Waiting. You'll process when the pressure lifts.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Going somewhere quiet where no one expects you to be okay yet.

questions.question: When you're creating something, you need:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Total isolation. Even ambient sound breaks the thread.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Deadlines and pressure. You work best against resistance.

answers.label: C
answers.text: A clear structure to work inside. Freedom within form.

answers.label: D
answers.text: The right conditions. If the environment is off, nothing comes out.
